note: One Piece bounties, oldest first ("luffy bounty", "zoro wanted poster"). Each amount from two sources; chapter and episode of the reveal only where two sources agree. Only the first is shown without a spoiler toggle.

entries.why: His first bounty, for beating Buggy, Don Krieg and Arlong: the highest in the East Blue, and the poster that makes him known as Straw Hat Luffy.
For defeating Crocodile, one of the Seven Warlords of the Sea.
For the attack on the World Government's judicial island to rescue Robin, where he beats Rob Lucci of CP9.
For punching a World Noble at Sabaody, breaking into Impel Down and joining the war at Marineford; shown when the story resumes after the two-year timeskip.
For defeating Doflamingo, another of the Seven Warlords.
For beating two of Big Mom's Sweet Commanders, Cracker and Katakuri, and escaping her territory. Luffy first misreads it as 150 million.
For defeating Kaido. He is named one of the Four Emperors, and Law and Kid get the same bounty.

His first bounty, for cutting down Mr. 1 (Daz Bonez) of Baroque Works in Arabasta and earlier beating around a hundred bounty hunters at Whisky Peak. The poster went out alongside Luffy's 100 million one.
Doubled after the crew declared war on the World Government at Enies Lobby, where Zoro beat CP9's Kaku. It made him the second most wanted Straw Hat, behind Luffy's 300 million.
Nearly tripled after Dressrosa, where he took down Pica, the mountain-sized Donquixote executive. Sanji later overtook it with 330 million after Whole Cake Island, to his great delight.

Set after the raid on Onigashima, where he beat King, one of Kaido's All-Stars. It is the highest bounty on the crew after Luffy's, just ahead of Jinbe's 1.1 billion and Sanji's 1.032 billion, and remains his current bounty.
His first bounty, for beating CP9's Jabra at Enies Lobby. The poster had no photo, only a badly wrong sketch of him, which became a running joke.

Raised after the crew's part in toppling Doflamingo at Dressrosa. The sketch was finally replaced by a photo, but the poster said "Only Alive", the only time that condition appears in the series, a hint of his father Vinsmoke Judge's hand.

Raised after he walked out on his arranged wedding and escaped Big Mom's territory with Luffy. It went back to "Dead or Alive" and edged past Zoro's 320 million, which delighted him until he saw the poster named him "Vinsmoke Sanji".

Set after the raid on Onigashima, where he beat Queen, one of Kaido's All-Stars. It ranks him fourth on the crew behind Luffy, Zoro and Jinbe, which leaves him furious, and remains his current bounty.
The bounty he already carried when he debuted on Sabaody as one of the Eleven Supernovas, the rookies worth over 100 million. The story never says exactly what earned it.
Raised during the two-year timeskip, then frozen when he became one of the Seven Warlords of the Sea by handing the Marines the hearts of a hundred pirates.
Reinstated and raised after he lost his Warlord title for allying with Luffy and helping bring down Doflamingo at Dressrosa. It matched Luffy's new 500 million exactly.
Set after he and Eustass Kid defeated the Emperor Big Mom on Onigashima. Law, Kid and Luffy were all given the same 3 billion, and it remains his current bounty.
His bounty as one of the Four Emperors, revealed when the Marines go over the Emperors' bounties after the Levely; the highest known for any pirate alive at the time.

His bounty as one of the Four Emperors, revealed when the Marines list the Emperors' bounties. It is the highest of any Emperor now active, even though he never seeks out fights. The numbers 4-8-9 can be read as "shi-ya-ku", a pun on Shanks.

His first bounty under his own name, after he knocked out Sugar and broke the toy curse at Dressrosa. The poster uses an unflattering photo of him passed out and calls him "God" Usopp, a title fans and the press gave him there. Before this, his only bounty was 30 million as "Sogeking", his masked alter ego, from Enies Lobby.

Raised after the raid on Onigashima, where he got the credit for taking down Kaido's officers Page One and Ulti, though he did not really beat either of them alone. The poster still says "God" Usopp, and the amount matches the 500 million Doflamingo put on his head in his Dressrosa game.

His bounty as second division commander of the Whitebeard Pirates, still in force when he was executed at Marineford. It was the highest bounty revealed before the timeskip, and the same as his crewmate Little Oars Jr.'s. The figure was first shown at the One Piece Ten exhibition, not in a chapter.

Her first bounty, for her part in the attack on Enies Lobby. The photo is a posed pin-up by a pool, which worried Genzo back home more than the bounty itself, and she was the only Straw Hat who complained about getting a bounty at all.
Raised by 50 million after the crew helped bring down Doflamingo at Dressrosa. The new photo is another posed poolside shot.
Raised by 300 million after the raid on Onigashima, where she beat Ulti with help from Zeus, the thundercloud she took from Big Mom. It is her current bounty.

His first money bounty, set during the timeskip after he left the Warlords, broke prisoners out of Impel Down and took Whitebeard's place as an Emperor. Before this, Kuma said his bounty was zero, and it was only revealed during Wano.
Raised after Kaido and Big Mom fell at Wano, for reasons the story does not give. It is the second highest among the current Emperors after Shanks, and 9-6 can be read as "kuro", meaning black.

Set when she was 8, after the Buster Call on Ohara, because she could read Poneglyphs; the Government claimed she sank six warships. The poster kept her childhood photo for twenty years, until a Marine in Arabasta recognised her from it.
Raised by just 1 million after the crew rescued her from Enies Lobby, but the poster finally swapped her childhood picture for a new adult photo.
Raised after the crew's part in toppling Doflamingo at Dressrosa.
Raised by 800 million after the raid on Onigashima, where she beat Black Maria, and because she can still read Poneglyphs. It is the highest Straw Hat bounty under a billion and her current one.
